the three references' parts are there: RTS camera and selection, walls that give way (js/world.js:583), a run with currency kept after death (js/sim.js:875)
angled 55 deg camera following the tank, wheel zoom, Q/E rotate in 90 deg steps (js/view.js updateCamera)
WASD hull, turret turns toward the mouse at turret_speed deg/s; dispersion widens moving and closes standing still, drawn as a circle (js/view.js:80)
a new voxel map each run: hills, ridged mountains, a mesa cut by a canyon, two lakes, a river with bridges; ruins, rocks and walls all blow apart (js/world.js:583)
Tab to command mode, click/box select, right-click move into cover or attack, F+right-click attack area; squads outside the radio radius refuse (js/sim.js:259)
squads of 1-4: rifle, sniper, MG, medic, mortar picked one by one, plus the armoured car; fallen soldiers replaced one by one (js/sim.js:896)
patrols, 5 camps and the fortress; raider rifleman, MG behind sandbags, rocket man, technical truck and the chief's tank each attack differently
workshop slots: cannon, tracks, engine, armour, radio, turret ring, stabiliser; each changes the tank's numbers and some its look
piastrine paid at the end of a run, spent on 4 permanent upgrades on the title and end screens (js/sim.js:100), kept in localStorage
turret lags the mouse at its own speed
spread from speed, hull turn and turret turn; settles with aim_time while still
sphere blast by material hardness, then unsupported voxels collapse (js/world.js:601)
seeded generation per run; every restart takes a new seed
move order finds cover cells facing the nearest threat; hotkeys 1-6, G follow, H hold
orders reach only squads inside the radio radius; radio parts and a perk widen it
parts bought with scrap at outposts
custom squads built soldier by soldier, replacements per fallen soldier
piastrine buy permanent upgrades between runs (thin: 4 upgrades)

an old raider wall of junk and red metal stands across the road a short drive out; shells blow it to voxels
the tutorial line asks for Tab and a move order; a rock stands beside the road for the squad (3 riflemen + a lone sniper)
a patrol of 3 raiders waits further along the road; the radio says to stop so the circle closes
